reviews.review_description: We are entirely new to Solar…. Simon, Josh and the team made the process so easy. They explained what we needed and how each the components work. They tailored our new system to our house and power needs.  Attention to detail on the install was first rate. From the cabling to the installation of the inverter they did a fantastic job. Installed all in one day and the system was up and running. Thanks to the whole team.

Simon was the only person I found who truly understood my requirements to run large 3 phase loads with big start up currents. I am very happy with the system he designed and the installation was completed in a very professional manner.

My 5.2kW solar power system was installed about a week ago by Brad and Dan from Towards Tomorrow Energy.The system uses top quality SMA and Sunpower equipment, and was installed in a professional, timely and very neat manner.The whole purchase experience was co-ordinated by Simon including a pre-inspection of the job before the equipment were ordered and a follow up with me which provided help with some questions I had after the job was complete.I am very happy with the way the system is working so far even on days that are not very clear, and couldn't be happier with Towards Tomorrow Energy, and I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a first rate system installed in a first rate manner.

Products in system are first class, American and German.ET Solar Panels, Hoppeche Batteries, Outback Inverter and controller.System is stand alone, 48VI am self installing, having required qualifications to save a little money.

Good morning Finn, we are going ahead and installing solar power, it has taken me approx. 6 months to make a decision,as you say there are many out there into the solar installation game and quotes vary a lot.Some companies want you to pay the full amount and then you have to wait to get the rebate, but the one I decided to go with was Towards Tomorrow Energy, which was one of your online quotes. Our system is booked in for installation on the 9th July, 2010, they organised all paperwork,within 10 days we recieved "Premission to Connect " paperwork from Integral Energy , they even sent me a list of Level 2 electricians in my area  for Gross Metre installation .So far everything is going well, will keep you informed of our progress  Regards Ted
Simon was fantastic from our first conversation. His knowledge of his product was first rate and the installation was seamless.
